description: Source code for IBM Guardrails Detector integration, defining the IBMGuardrailDetector class with methods for detection, guardrail status determination, and hooks for pre- and post-LLM call processing.

classes.name: IBMGuardrailDetector
classes.description: A class for detecting guardrail violations using IBM Guardrails, with methods for calling detection APIs, filtering detections, determining guardrail status, and hooks for LLM call lifecycle events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the IBMGuardrailDetector with configuration parameters and sets up the HTTP client and API URL.

methods.name: _call_detector_server
methods.description: Calls the IBM detector server API with provided contents and logs the response.

methods.name: _call_orchestrator
methods.description: Calls the IBM orchestrator API for a single content string and logs the response.

methods.name: _filter_detections_by_threshold
methods.description: Filters detections based on the configured score threshold.

methods.name: _determine_guardrail_status_detector_server
methods.description: Determines guardrail status ('success', 'guardrail_intervened', 'guardrail_failed_to_respond') based on detector server response.

methods.name: _determine_guardrail_status_orchestrator
methods.description: Determines guardrail status based on orchestrator response.

methods.name: _create_error_message_detector_server
methods.description: Creates a detailed error message listing violations from detector server response.

methods.name: _create_error_message_orchestrator
methods.description: Creates a detailed error message listing violations from orchestrator response.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Hook executed before LLM call to detect violations in input messages.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Hook executed in parallel to LLM call to detect violations in input messages.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Hook executed after successful LLM response to detect violations in output.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Passes streaming response items to the guardrail for inspection.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for IBM detector guardrails.
